# Custom partition table for ESP32-P4 /: # factory is 8MB: the app carries the ESP-DL YOLO model in its rodata.
# Measured with an untrimmed esp-dl: 2.9MB model + ~2.8MB of esp-dl pixel
# conversion tables + 0.64MB of app = ~6.3MB. Trimming the unused pixel
# conversion paths (CONFIG_PIX_CVT_*) in sdkconfig.defaults cuts a few MB
# but the partition is sized for the untrimmed worst case so it cannot bite.
#   - factory must stay at offset 0x10000: flash.ps1 hardcodes the app address.
#   - the partition table itself sits at 0x8000

it exists to keep the bootloader that small.
